content.text:
Updated 16 hours ago
Robinhood Leads Friday’s S&P 500 Gains
Robinhood was Friday’s best performer in the S&P 500 index, up 13.7%. Shares of the fintech company saw their largest percent increase since February, when they rose 13.95%.
The company hit its highest close since July 15, with share prices closing at about $108.
